brandValues.name: Community
brandValues.description: Kids deserve peers who understand them and queer adults they can look up to. We build that community by spending our days together.

brandValues.name: Affirmation
brandValues.description: Names and pronouns matter. So does having room to try things, change, and become yourself without being put on the spot.

brandValues.name: Equity
brandValues.description: Cost and individual needs should be part of the conversation, not reasons to stop it. We work with families on scholarships and support.
